offering_description.value: Provides background screening, identity verification and risk assessment services to employers, landlords and other businesses. It delivers them mainly through a cloud platform and integrations with hiring and property management systems, charging per report or per transaction.

primary_products.value: screening reports; identity verification software; risk assessment platforms

primary_services.value: employment background screening; drug and health testing; tenant screening; verification services

customer_segment.value: B2B: employers, staffing firms, landlords, property managers, lenders and other businesses

end_markets.value: human resources; real estate; financial services; gig economy; healthcare

revenue_model.value: service fees: per-report fees for background, drug and verification checks; subscription: platform access and software licenses for screening workflows; transaction or usage fees: usage-based charges for identity and data verification
revenue_model.category: service fees; subscription; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: runs screening and verification for clients, sold to employers and landlords; software / platform: cloud screening platform and integrations, sold to hiring and property teams

geography_served.value: global: US national operations with offices and screening coverage in many other countries

specialization.value: related lines: employment screening, tenant screening, identity verification and drug testing sharing data and customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to national employers and large property managers; online: self-service ordering and cloud screening platform; partners / resellers: integrations with applicant tracking and HR software providers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: consumer reporting and privacy rules such as the US Fair Credit Reporting Act, state screening laws and GDPR
